C1292.title: Over 20 Payment Institutions Fined More Than RMB 170 Million in First Half of 2026
C1292.summary: In the first half of 2026, incomplete statistics show that over 20 third-party payment institutions were penalized by regulators for violations, with total fines exceeding RMB 170 million. Among them, Ezipay was fined over RMB 48 million for breaches of payment and settlement, fintech, and anti-money laundering rules, marking the year's largest penalty.
